summary: Hosted Durable Objects for Project replication and supervised generation. The local Host remains the local Project authority.
context_hints: Public transports must authenticate before framework handlers read or mutate state. Raw client headers do not establish internal authority.
Connection authorization evidence is server-owned and contains no raw credentials. Revalidate before messages and private delivery; old connections without evidence must reconnect.

key_files.project-room.ts: Remote Loro sequencer and fan-out with durable replica persistence and connection authorization.
key_files.supervisor.ts: AIChatAgent adapter. Constructor guards wrap the framework-installed handlers; guarding only the subclass onMessage misses chat history, clear and resume protocol effects. HTTP fetch and outgoing broadcasts also enforce authorization.
